credit_line: Alfred Stieglitz Collection—Bequest of Georgia O'Keeffe
description: A sharp silver fishhook with bright red and yellow feathers occupies the upper left corner of the page. Attached to the hook is a coil of fishing line. A soft sea- or skyscape fills the background of the work. Through the coil of fishing line, the blue and white background appears slightly refracted, as though it is seen through glass or water.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
